# only address that differs from the before dump is 0x0784, 0x50 -> 0x28, the
# same move `0751-isolation-example-active.csv` records -- the two fixtures
# agree on purpose, so the windowed read and the whole-block read can be held
# to the same number. 0x0751 reads 0x10 in both dumps, because this pair is
# about what a PL move looks like on its own and §4.6's readback is not the
# branch under test. Every value here is invented; not a prediction that a
# real page looks like this or that a PL moves.
